recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recjOcHdZb0eZHeUx.Name: Dani Katz

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Dani's path to quantum languaging", "body": "Dani Katz traces her word work from a bookish childhood in Los Angeles through journalism grad school and nine years writing for the LA Weekly, where tight deadlines made wordplay a daily practice. After what she calls a shamanic initiation around 2007, she read R. Neville Johnson's Hidden Language Codes, and words began speaking to her in layered, multidimensional ways. She calls the resulting body of work quantum languaging, a name she kept despite branding advice because, she says, language programs us on many levels at once, from personal habits to the collective reality construct. Chance shares his own sudden awakening when he could feel what letters meant."}, {"title": "Tweaking English rather than replacing it", "body": "Chance asks whether English really is a slave language, arguing that its phonetics carry seeds of every other tongue. Dani answers that it is both: she believes English has been tainted with enslavement codes and a contrived hierarchy, so talk of equality spoken in hierarchical language cannot deliver empowerment, yet small tweaks within English can liberate us. Her signature example is saying the powers that were, which she says refuses to ratify their false power. The same principle, language the sucky stuff in the past, applies to old habits like sugar or caffeine cravings, while what we want gets spoken in the present."}, {"title": "Loosening the grip of I am", "body": "Chance notes that English speakers say I am sad where other languages say I have sadness, and asks how to express the shadow without owning it. Dani prefers verbing, as in noticing some anxious thing, because saying I am anxious hands the feeling a key to your house and the guest room. She points to Krishnamurti catching his own I am statements mid lecture and says the Mayan language had no I am verb. Chance hears not icing inside noticing and links the bare I am to a zero point of pure potential, while Dani calls identification a cage."}, {"title": "Astrology, duality and the devil as denial", "body": "Chance wonders whether the zodiac is a collective story that could be rewritten or something encoded in nature and the seasons. Dani, an amateur student of astrology, answers that it is probably both, citing Rudolf Steiner's view of the moon and her sense that reality is built on agreement. They turn to the phrase non-dual, which Dani suspects fragments the very thing it names. Chance offers the hermetic idea of polarity as a thing and its lack, and argues the Vatican set God and devil up as adversaries, while Dani shares the Right Use of Will books, which cast the devil as God's denial."}, {"title": "Languaging goals and wholeness", "body": "Dani describes her coaching as using a 5D ear to find the gaps between what clients say, what they want and what shows up. She argues that fear-based, worst-case medical language programs people at their most vulnerable, and Chance, who now prefers the word wholeness to healing, calls division the mother of monsters. On goals, Chance credits a one-line journal note thanking his spirit team, and Dani teaches present tense claiming, jumping five goals ahead, and treating a claim that makes you want to cry as a breadcrumb pointing to a fragmented part that needs integration, which she likens to soul retrieval."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The rebellious orator and speech superhero Dani Katz of the Word Up Podcast joins InnerVerse for a live episode where we'll get to know her and the work she does with multidimensional coaching to take clients beyond the diction of Aries deaf-initions. How do our words program our world and help or hinder our mental connection to meaning?
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the second hour, we get into Dani's transformative NDE, our similar spontaneous temporary enlightenment experiences, the right way to talk to normies about conspiracy, the polarity of witchcraft, words that have etymological meanings opposite to our modern definitions, and much more!
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "It seems that a lot of the things that we say, when we go further into the details of the origins of those phonetics, we find that we're actually contradicting ourselves left and right.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "We language reality the way we want to see it and then density will catch up. So when I say the powers that were, I'm choosing to not ratify any of these beings' false power.", "author": "Dani Katz", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bb844f02-a757-4c83-b582-38a28ae71db5/DANI-KATZ.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Anything that we don't want to see more of, language it in the past, which frees us up and signals to our subconscious mind.", "author": "Dani Katz", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bb844f02-a757-4c83-b582-38a28ae71db5/DANI-KATZ.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I still think noticing takes the cake, and the reason is because you get into the green language of that word, and the very first thing that pops out is I'm not icing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "If I say I am anxious, then it's like I've just given it the key to my house and set it up in the guest room.", "author": "Dani Katz", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bb844f02-a757-4c83-b582-38a28ae71db5/DANI-KATZ.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If you leave your zero point at zero, then you're always in this pivotal place, literally where you can pivot in any direction.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "From my perspective, identification is enslavement. So anything that I am saying I am is me putting myself in a cage and limiting my experience.", "author": "Dani Katz", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bb844f02-a757-4c83-b582-38a28ae71db5/DANI-KATZ.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "One thing that we're still developing as humans is the mastery of knowing what we want and being able to ask for it.", "author": "Dani Katz", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bb844f02-a757-4c83-b582-38a28ae71db5/DANI-KATZ.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Humans treat themselves like they're the top of a totem pole of sorts, but in another sense this realm is the bottom floor of the ocean and we're underwater right now.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/aa717e55-9487-4255-a7df-3f8ef10940c4/Chance+Garton+Patreon+Portrait.png?content-type=image%2Fpng"}, {"text": "For everyone listening, you have the right to author your story however you want to, as kind, as fun, as compassionate, as abundant, as healthy as you want to.", "author": "Dani Katz", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/bb844f02-a757-4c83-b582-38a28ae71db5/DANI-KATZ.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
